title: Microsoft.Entra/policies/claimsMappingPolicies
description: A claims mapping policy (claimsMappingPolicy). The resource name is the displayName; it is looked up by displayName on every run (more than one match is an error). Assigned to service principals with their claimsMappingPolicies edge.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

definition.description: Required: one policy document, {"ClaimsMappingPolicy":{"Version":1,"IncludeBasicClaimSet":"true","ClaimsSchema":[...]}}, as a JSON string or (sugar) an object. At most 50 ClaimsSchema entries and 50 transformations (Graph ignores the rest). Compared by JSON content.

isOrganizationDefault.description: Must be false (or absent): Graph applies claims mapping to service principals only.

permissions.notes: Learn (claimsmappingpolicy-post-claimsmappingpolicies, -update, -delete): Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguration is the least privileged write permission (delegated and application); claimsmappingpolicy-list reads with Policy.Read.All (a known issue may require consenting to both). Learn names no role on the API pages; the claims customization how-to uses Application Administrator. Assigning the policy (the claimsMappingPolicies edge) needs Application.ReadWrite.All (Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy for owned objects) and Policy.Read.All instead.
